notes: Carry the shared Windows 11-inspired finish through popups, drive forms, Library tools, login, statistics, playlist previews and action rows. Unify typography, control spacing, readable text and theme-aware status colours.

Replace browser confirmations with matching accessible app dialogs. Cancel is focused by default; Escape cancels without dismissing the underlying popup. Confirmation requests are queued and complete before actions run.
Improve small-screen popup sizing, long-title wrapping and reduced-motion support. Preserve all warnings, confirmation wording and destination-verification safeguards.

Make every main-menu section a page under the persistent header, including Settings at /preferences. Remove page-level Home/Close controls, retain popup Close buttons, and protect unsaved settings when switching pages. Saving and discarding keep Settings open.
